scope: Bounded hypothetical manufacturing amendment cases; industrial surface-water discharge, not domestic wastewater or feed production. Not a complete regulatory applicability audit.

P2_2026.title: Permen LH/BPLH 2 Tahun 2026
P2_2026.note: Partial repeal for specific feed-sector provisions; does not justify treating all of P5 as repealed or unchanged. The affected drain/formation provisions are not encoded in this spike.

PP22:89-90.use: Environmental approval amendment; capacity increase needs the new-environmental-documentation route, while a complete set of encoded administrative/management changes follows the route without a new environmental document. The latter does not mean no paperwork or no approval. Mixed changes are not treated as administrative-only.

PP22:93.2.use: Management/monitoring changes requiring technical approval are based on a technical approval change.

P5:3.use: AMDAL/UKL-UPL activities conducting surface-water wastewater discharge must have technical approval and SLO. Obligation existence does not mean a new issuance is always needed or already satisfied.

P5:15.use: Technical wastewater changes including treatment design and wastewater management require technical approval amendment. The spike assumes evidenced prior Pertek and a direct surface-water discharge route.

P5:16.1.a.use: Changed impact-spread extent leads to technical study attachment. The physical finding is input evidence, not predicted by OWL.

P5:16.1.b.use: Explicit unchanged impact-spread extent leads to standards-compliance technical documentation. Unknown is not unchanged.

P5:16.2.use: Articles 8-12 apply mutatis mutandis to technical approval amendment.

P5:8.1.use: AMDAL technical application can be concurrent with or precede environmental application; no strict before-only rule.

P5:8.2.use: UKL-UPL technical application precedes environmental application. Application is distinguished from issuance.

P5:14.use: Technical approval is a prerequisite for environmental approval issuance. Not a claim that every technical approval must be issued before environmental application.

MODEL:closure.use: Universal closure over project changes is asserted only if the fixture explicitly certifies a complete inventory. Open-world absence does not establish exclusivity.

MODEL:screening.use: Proposed-project AMDAL/UKL screening is supplied as a hypothetical verified input. Historical approval does not automatically establish the changed project's regime.
